description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Triplicate Titan, adding {C}{C}.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Triplicate Titan trigger, creating three creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
